scope: Private same-ELF nominal-step exact zero-normal/zero-prior-friction guard. Both arms use one pooled EE solver function and shared VU0 packets with the same world-first chained schedule. All contacts and six/three normal/position passes remain. Coverage must show actual skipped zero updates only in the candidate; admission retains exact initialized-state/contact snapshots and full ordered fingerprints. Timing requires this same admitted ELF without shadow checks. No production-clock FPS claim.
